_comment: Template for ~/.config/apstats/.payout-agent.json (the DOGE payout agent's config). Copy it there, fill in payoutAgentKey, keep the file private. Every key below is read by loadAgentConfig() in tools/doge-payout-agent.mjs; env vars ROSTER_URL / PAYOUT_AGENT_KEY / TEACHER_KEY / DOGE_CLI / DOGE_WALLET / DOGE_SOURCE_ACCOUNT / PAYOUT_FEE_HEADROOM / POLL_SECONDS / PAYOUT_BATCH_CAP / PAYOUT_JOURNAL override the same fields. NEVER commit a filled-in copy.
_teacherKey: Optional fallback auth if PAYOUT_AGENT_KEY is unset on Railway. Prefer the dedicated agent key; leave this out.
_sourceAccount: Legacy Dogecoin Core account charged by sendmany, separate from walletName. Empty means the default account. Choose an account with enough bookkeeping balance; '*' is a read-only aggregate and cannot send. The agent checks both this account (1 confirmation) and the wallet's spendable balance before arming a payout.
_journalPath: Defaults to .doge-send-journal.json in the working directory (the repo root) so the agent and a manual tools/doge-send.mjs run share one send lock. Only set it if you know why.
